pointOfInterests.description: the put in Is right in the day use area of the Fort Jackson Park the put in is the mouth of big hollow brook where the end of the river creates a nice eddie. if you want there is some fun low volume creeking upstream 300 feet. put in is pretty daunting if its your first time whitewater kayaking but the left side of the river is pretty chill and you can skirt around the waves in the middle.
pointOfInterests.name: Put In

pointOfInterests.description: Take out is just after the bridge, early season this can be inidated with Ice flows. Watch out for barbed wire when nearing the road you can barely see it but it would suck to step on it. ALSO before the bridge is a bull feild so dont wear anything red.
pointOfInterests.name: Take Out

detail.description:
Perfect class I-II beginner river, there is nonstop rapids from put-in to take out, There is a nice day campsite at the put-in if you wish to have a feast before or after the trip. there is an alternate put-in upstream if you want to hit some class 3 aswell. run this river with beginners to learn skills in and around the numerous rocks down the river, at higher flows the first 1000 feet below the campsite might be pretty scary for beginners.
